hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored arYuleWalker (Durbin-Levinson on the biased ACF) reproduces statsmodels.regression.yule_walker(method='mle') BIT-FOR-BIT for both the AR coefficients and the innovation variance; and the fitted AR(4) is stationary (all roots of the AR polynomial lie outside the unit circle).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: arYuleWalker equals statsmodels.regression.yule_walker(method='mle') to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9 for coefficients and variance)
